safety.cappedSingleDose: Calculated dose was {{calculated}} {{unit}}. It was CAPPED because the maximum single dose is {{max}} {{unit}}.
safety.noSingleDoseCeiling: No maximum single dose is defined for this drug, so the dose could not be capped automatically. Verify against the label.
safety.exceedsDailyMax: DAILY DOSE EXCEEDED: total {{daily}} {{unit}} against a daily maximum of {{max}} {{unit}}. Reduce the dosing frequency.
safety.noDailyCeiling: No daily maximum is defined for this drug, so the daily dose could not be checked.
safety.unknownFrequency: Dosing frequency '{{frequency}}' is not recognised. The daily total could not be computed and THE DAILY DOSE CHECK WAS NOT PERFORMED. Verify the daily total manually.
safety.unscheduledFrequency: '{{frequency}}' has no fixed interval. The daily total shown reflects a single administration only; the daily ceiling was not checked automatically.
safety.noMatchingAgeBand: Patient age ({{age}}) falls outside the age bands defined for this drug. NO age-based adjustment was applied.
safety.renalAdjustmentApplied: Renal function {{value}} {{unit}}: dose adjusted by a factor of {{factor}}×.
safety.renalImpairmentNoRule: RENAL IMPAIRMENT DETECTED ({{value}} {{unit}}) but no verified renal dosing rule exists for this drug. NO renal adjustment was applied — review the dose manually.
safety.renalNotAssessed: Renal function was not assessed because no serum creatinine was entered. Check whether a renal dose adjustment is required.
safety.pediatricEgfr: Paediatric patient: renal function estimated with the Schwartz formula as eGFR {{value}} mL/min/1.73m² (Cockcroft-Gault is not validated in children).
safety.crclObesityCaveat: BMI ≥ 30: Cockcroft-Gault uses total body weight and may overestimate clearance. Verify using an adjusted body weight.
safety.pediatricReview: Paediatric patient. Paediatric doses must be independently verified by a second healthcare professional.
safety.unverifiedSource: This dosing rule has not passed independent clinical review (UNVERIFIED). Compare against the official product information before use.
safety.overlappingAgeBands: This drug has overlapping age bands (age {{age}} matches more than one). The most restrictive rule was used; the drug record needs correcting.
safety.sourceCheckedOnly: This dosing rule has only been compared against a public source ({{source}}, {{date}}); it has not been clinically signed off. Verify against the official product information before use.

blocked.title: Calculation Not Possible
blocked.missingFormula: No dosing formula is defined for this drug. Calculation is not possible.
blocked.nonNumericInput: Patient values are not numeric. Check the age, weight and height fields.
blocked.negativeInput: Weight and height cannot be negative.
blocked.unsupportedWeight: Weight cannot exceed {{max}} kg. Check the input.
blocked.unsupportedHeight: Height cannot exceed {{max}} cm. Check the input.
blocked.unsupportedCreatinine: Serum creatinine cannot exceed {{max}} mg/dL. Check the input.
blocked.weightRequired: This drug is dosed by weight; enter a valid weight.
blocked.bsaRequired: This drug is dosed by body surface area; enter a valid height and weight.
blocked.renalDataRequired: This drug requires a renal dose adjustment. Enter the serum creatinine value.
blocked.missingDosePerKg: The drug record is missing its mg/kg dose. A safe calculation is not possible.
blocked.missingDosePerM2: The drug record is missing its mg/m² dose. A safe calculation is not possible.
blocked.missingFixedDose: The drug record is missing its fixed dose. A safe calculation is not possible.
blocked.unknownMethod: Unknown calculation method. Calculation is not possible.
blocked.nonFiniteResult: The calculation did not produce a valid result. Check the inputs.
blocked.contraindicatedAge: {{drug}} is CONTRAINDICATED at this age ({{age}}). No dose was calculated.
blocked.clinicalReviewRequired: Dose calculation for {{drug}} is pending clinical review. {{note}}
blocked.contraindicatedRenal: {{drug}} is CONTRAINDICATED at this level of kidney function ({{value}} {{unit}}). No dose was calculated.

blocked.invalidPatient: Patient values are invalid. Check weight, height and age.
blocked.implausiblePatient: Patient values are outside physiological limits. Check the inputs.
blocked.noProtocolRate: No protocol dosing rate (mg/m² or mg/kg) is recorded for {{drug}}. No dose is calculated from a default rate.
blocked.aucRequired: {{drug}} is dosed by AUC. Enter the target AUC value.
blocked.gfrRequired: The Calvert equation for {{drug}} requires a measured GFR. Enter a GFR or a serum creatinine.

safety.doseCapped: Calculated dose was {{calculated}} mg. It was CAPPED because the ceiling for this patient is {{max}} mg.
safety.gfrCapped: Measured GFR was {{measured}} mL/min; it was capped at {{cap}} mL/min in the Calvert equation to avoid overdosing.
safety.pediatric: PAEDIATRIC PATIENT. These protocols are adult protocols; paediatric oncology dosing must be calculated separately.
safety.elderly: Elderly patient (>70). Dose reduction and a performance-status assessment may be required.
safety.renalNotAssessed: Renal function was not measured. Do not approve a nephrotoxic agent without a GFR.
safety.moderateRenal: Renal impairment (GFR {{gfr}} mL/min). Dose reduction may be required.
safety.severeRenal: SEVERE renal impairment (GFR {{gfr}} mL/min). This agent may be contraindicated.
safety.largeBsa: BSA is {{bsa}} m². Many protocols cap BSA at 2.0 m²; check your institutional protocol.
safety.unverified: This chemotherapy dosing rule has not passed independent clinical review. Verify against your institutional protocol.
safety.noCeiling: No verified absolute dose ceiling is defined for this drug, so the dose could not be capped automatically. Verify against your institutional protocol.
